findings.detail: The theorem universally fixes n : Nat with n >= 3 and kappa : Real with kappa >= 4. Those are precisely the single-block standing ranges repeated in A2.SS2.p2. No d, k, T, algorithm, spectral, kernel, integrability or Gaussian-measurability premise has been added.

singleBlockPrecision is exactly ((kappa+1)/2) I - ((kappa-1)/4)(O+transpose O), matching Eq4. The covariance in gamma is the inverse of that precision. The zero mean and real n-dimensional Euclidean space match N(0,A_O^{-1}).

The family uses the stated existing multivariateGaussian constructor at the literal inverse matrix, rather than an arbitrary law, a supplied density or a placeholder family. Positive definiteness and agreement with the source density must be established internally or by the claimed exact prior parent; they are not assumptions of this theorem. That parent has not been inspected by this reviewer.

nu_pos and nu_neg are exactly 2 times restrictions of the stated full O(n) Haar probability to the determinant +1 and -1 events. Source S2.p2 states each has Haar mass 1/2, so these are precisely the normalized conditional laws. This is not conditioning Haar on SO(n) a second time, choosing separate Haar laws, or replacing the two signs by arbitrary priors.

Each mixture is literally Measure.bind of its normalized prior with the same actual Gaussian family on Borel Euclidean space. Measurable gamma is a conclusion, so a nonmeasurable map fallback cannot satisfy the full conjunction. The two Borel-set identities identify the bind with the intended integral of component masses.

B and MeasurableSet B are universally quantified inside each conclusion, restricting the asserted evaluation formula to Borel sets. They are not theorem-level assumptions or a restriction to one chosen test set. All let-bound objects are fixed by n and kappa; neither sign introduces an extra parameter.

The authors define P_b as an expectation of Gaussian measures and subsequently use its density and expectations. The supplied regions contain no proof of measurability of O -> Gaussian(0,A_O^{-1}), no bind construction, and no probability-preservation proof. The sealed theorem is legitimate formal well-definedness bookkeeping for this definition, but its detailed proof must not be attributed to the authors.

The statement concerns only single-block actual mixtures. It does not assert Eq6's independent-block factorization, the H expectation-difference identity, the total-variation inequality, Gaussian Poisson formulas, transcript claims or a lower bound.
